pub type zenpipe::PipeResult<T> = core::result::Result<T, whereat::at::At<zenpipe::PipeError>>
pub type zenpipe::PixelFormat = zenpixels::descriptor::PixelDescriptor
pub type zenpipe::Strip<'a> = zenpixels::buffer::PixelSlice<'a>
